response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price FROM rating_stats), filtered_ratings AS (SELECT rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.daily_price, rs.daily_price - ca.avg_daily_price AS excess FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca WHERE rs.daily_price > ca.avg_daily_price) SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost), AVG(daily_price), AVG(excess) FROM filtered_ratings
